title: Recovering a corrupted MyISAM table: incident walkthrough
lede: A WooCommerce wp_options table crashed on a shared host at 23:41. Ninety minutes, no SSH, only phpMyAdmin and FTP. Here's the incident in order.
hero_alt: Overhead photo on bone linen: paper repair log for wp_options, phpMyAdmin printout, MyISAM schematic, wax seal.
